get.description:
SSE stream that emits driver location updates for an assigned pickup request. Only available for 'assigned', 'truck_dispatched', and 'en_route' statuses. Customer authentication required.

This is a Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream) endpoint — keep the connection open and listen for the named events below. A `ping` heartbeat is emitted every 30s if no location update occurs.

**Event: `connected`** — emitted once when the stream opens. Confirms which driver/truck is being tracked.
```text
event: connected
data: {"pickupRequestId":"019fc0d2-0720-766c-a65f-2e5281347399","driverId":"019f9fe9-4a06-75fd-b77a-1209a3de2839","driverName":"Babatunde Lawal","zoneName":"East Legon","truckId":"019d8d52-dae6-7111-a5bb-c76bc0edab82","truckPlate":"jdjdjd"}
```

**Event: `location`** — emitted each time the driver pushes a GPS update.
```text
event: location
data: {"driverId":"019f9fe9-4a06-75fd-b77a-1209a3de2839","driverName":"Babatunde Lawal","zoneName":"East Legon","truckId":"019d8d52-dae6-7111-a5bb-c76bc0edab82","truckPlate":"jdjdjd","lng":-0.3306102,"lat":5.7124757,"accuracy":26.399999618530273,"speed":0,"heading":0,"pickupAssignmentId":"019fc263-a956-7078-9c20-afb26e09fd0d","recordedAt":"2026-08-03T23:24:29.547Z","isOnline":true}
```

**Event: `ping`** — heartbeat emitted every 30 seconds when there is no location update (keeps the connection alive). `data` is `null`.
```text
event: ping
data: null
```

**`location` data fields:**
- `driverId` (uuid) — the driver being tracked
- `driverName` (string) — driver display name
- `zoneName` (string) — the driver's zone
- `truckId` (uuid) — assigned truck
- `truckPlate` (string) — truck plate number
- `lng` (number) — longitude
- `lat` (number) — latitude
- `accuracy` (number|null) — GPS accuracy in meters
- `speed` (number|null) — speed in m/s
- `heading` (number|null) — bearing in degrees
- `pickupAssignmentId` (uuid|null) — the active assignment, if any
- `recordedAt` (ISO string) — when the fix was recorded
- `isOnline` (boolean) — always true on live updates

get.description:
Admin endpoint — SSE stream that emits a `location` event every time the specified driver pushes a location update.

This is a Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream) endpoint — keep the connection open and listen for the named events below. A `ping` heartbeat is emitted every 15s if no location update occurs.

**Event: `connected`** — emitted once when the stream opens.
```text
event: connected
data: {"driverId":"019f9fe9-4a06-75fd-b77a-1209a3de2839","driverName":"Babatunde Lawal","zoneName":"East Legon","truckId":"019d8d52-dae6-7111-a5bb-c76bc0edab82","truckPlate":"jdjdjd"}
```

**Event: `location`** — emitted each time the driver pushes a GPS update.
```text
event: location
data: {"driverId":"019f9fe9-4a06-75fd-b77a-1209a3de2839","driverName":"Babatunde Lawal","zoneName":"East Legon","truckId":"019d8d52-dae6-7111-a5bb-c76bc0edab82","truckPlate":"jdjdjd","lng":-0.3306102,"lat":5.7124757,"accuracy":26.399999618530273,"speed":0,"heading":0,"pickupAssignmentId":"019fc263-a956-7078-9c20-afb26e09fd0d","recordedAt":"2026-08-03T23:24:29.547Z","isOnline":true}
```

**Event: `ping`** — heartbeat emitted every 15 seconds when there is no location update. `data` is `null`.
```text
event: ping
data: null
```

get.description:
Admin endpoint — SSE stream that emits a `location` event every time any driver pushes a location update.

This is a Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream) endpoint — keep the connection open and listen for the named events below. A `ping` heartbeat is emitted every 15s if no location update occurs.

**Event: `connected`** — emitted once when the stream opens.
```text
event: connected
data: {"message":"Tracking all drivers"}
```

**Event: `location`** — emitted each time any driver pushes a GPS update. Use `driverId` to route each update to the right marker.

event: location
data: {"driverId":"019f9fe9-4a06-75fd-b77a-1209a3de2839","driverName":"Babatunde Lawal","zoneName":"East Legon","truckId":"019d8d52-dae6-7111-a5bb-c76bc0edab82","truckPlate":"jdjdjd","lng":-0.3306102,"lat":5.7124757,"accuracy":26.399999618530273,"speed":0,"heading":0,"pickupAssignmentId":"019fc263-a956-7078-9c20-afb26e09fd0d","recordedAt":"2026-08-03T23:24:29.547Z","isOnline":true}

**Event: `ping`** — heartbeat emitted every 15 seconds when there is no location update. `data` is `null`.

event: ping
